{{Quote|For hundreds of years we have bred our Aaroun for warrior entertainment. Ours is more than combat, it is graceful... beauty and brutality woven together. To introduce impure elements into choreography would be to demean the fates of our fair Aaroun.|Dahlomad Tkhii|<ref name="HNN53">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|sports/13425_1.html|Proposed Galaxy Gladiator Federation Falling Apart}}</ref>}}
The '''Aaroun''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of carnivores. The powerful beings were covered in golden fur. The species were bred as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]] by the [[Viis Empire]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a significant polity in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] until it was decimated by the [[Changeling/Legends|shape shifting]], malevolent entity known as the [[Mnggal-Mnggal]].<ref name="Unknown">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The genesis of the Aaroun is found in [[W:c:lucasfilm:Alien Chronicles|''Alien Chronicles'']], a science-fiction trilogy authored by [[Wikipedia:Deborah Chester|Deborah Chester]], published by [[Wikipedia:Ace Books|Ace Books]], and commissioned by [[Lucasfilm]] The Aaroun were illustrated for ''Alien Chronicles'' by [[Terryl Whitlatch]], who designed creatures for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and went on to illustrate ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''.
